message: job test in .github/workflows/ci.yml (line 7) runs bundle config set --local cooldown 0, which writes cooldown 0 into .bundle/config and turns off the cooldown of Bundler for the later bundle commands, in place of the cooldown: of the Gemfile
fix: Remove that bundle config command from .github/workflows/ci.yml, so that the cooldown: of the Gemfile applies; for a gem that cannot wait, run bundle update GEM --cooldown 0 by hand after reviewing it
